name: 68133 · Papillion, NE
findings: ZIP 68133 (Papillion) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 68133 (Papillion) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 68133 (Papillion) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).
